business-context.instructions: Describe business outcomes, target audiences, markets, languages, journey steps and success definitions.
business-context.fallback: Use a scoped interview; keep unconfirmed definitions unknown.

rendered-page.instructions: Provide rendered DOM plus URL, capture time, device and HTTP response; retain extraction failures.
rendered-page.fallback: Supply repository templates and mark runtime checks pending.

content-sources.instructions: Supply claims and their authoritative sources, intended audience and review dates.
content-sources.fallback: Assess only supplied claims; request domain review for unsupported material.

search-export.instructions: Export page/query data with property identity, date range, filters, timezone, pagination and source metadata.
search-export.fallback: Supply attributed dashboard observations with limitations; public crawling cannot prove index state.

ga4-report.instructions: Supply GA4 runReport pages with property, query, dates, metric definitions, timezone, currency and pagination.
ga4-report.fallback: Use supplied report export; keep account configuration and instrumentation checks separate.

gtm-container.instructions: Export the GTM container version being tested; identify environment, tags, triggers, variables and version.
gtm-container.fallback: Supply scoped configuration screenshots and browser traces; preserve unobserved dependencies.

tracking-trace.instructions: Capture action, dataLayer, tag/network observations, event identity and timestamps using approved test identities. Remove secrets/PII.
tracking-trace.fallback: Provide a redacted trace export; leave unavailable links in the event chain unknown.

consent-policy.instructions: Supply intended consent modes, regions, default state, updates/revocation and applicable tag behavior.
consent-policy.fallback: Record technical observations only; do not infer legal compliance.

consent-trace.instructions: Supply before/after traces for defaults, reject, accept, selective choices, revoke and persistence with region and mode.
consent-trace.fallback: Provide manual Tag Assistant evidence with timestamps; mark untested scenarios pending.

performance-observations.access: Public lab or authorized RUM export
performance-observations.instructions: Supply field URL/origin/device/window and lab configuration/repeats separately; preserve no-data results.
performance-observations.fallback: Run allowed lab captures; request RUM and do not substitute lab for field.

accessibility-observations.access: Read-only inspection or approved test journey
accessibility-observations.instructions: Provide automated findings with tool versions plus manual keyboard/focus/error-recovery evidence and tested criteria.
accessibility-observations.fallback: Supply manual walkthrough evidence; do not infer conformance from an automated score.

journey-observations.access: Approved test journey or supplied research
journey-observations.instructions: Document each journey step, observed friction, device, failures and funnel/research provenance.
journey-observations.fallback: Provide a recorded walkthrough; label heuristic advice as hypotheses.

business-observations.instructions: Supply outcome status taxonomy, pseudonymous correlation keys, event times, window and source; include failures and unmatched records.
business-observations.fallback: Provide attributed manual observations; analytics events alone cannot confirm terminal outcomes.

optimization-scope.access: Explicit change scope, no implicit deployment
optimization-scope.instructions: Identify assets, environment, owners, authorized action classes, acceptance checks and rollback constraints.
optimization-scope.fallback: Produce a recommendation backlog without applying changes.

rules.question: Can the declared pages be discovered and interpreted?
Are claims and intended answers supported?
What do attributable search observations establish?
Does measurement represent the intended business definitions?
Does the action map through instrumentation to the intended outcome?
Does observed tag behavior match the supplied consent policy?
What do field and lab measurements separately establish?
Which criteria and journeys were actually evaluated?
Which friction is observed and which improvement remains a hypothesis?
What changes are authorized and verifiable?
